description: This is the main entry point of a React application that initializes the rendering process by attaching the root component to the DOM element with id 'root'. It imports React and ReactDOM, along with associated CSS and App component.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React rendering root to control the DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React element tree into the DOM.
